responsibility: Provides the MicroBlaze GNU/Linux subtarget configuration layered on top of the generic MicroBlaze ELF port. It fixes Linux-specific driver and linker behavior, including predefined CPP options, PIC and TLS defaults, dynamic linker paths for glibc/uClibc/musl, endian-sensitive linker flags, GNU user OS builtins, and file-end assembly handling for executable-stack notes.
